hud_and_gameplay_features.description: Displays weapon traits and specialties inside Backpack for quick reference

optimizations_and_fixes: Optimizations to gameplay experience and smoothness on Alpine map
Auto-equip all items obtained from weapon chests in Training Grounds
Enhanced explosion visual effects in Bomb Squad mode
Updated ammo icons for Shotguns and Pistols
Added 'Like' button for First Blood, Triple Kill, and Quadra Kill announcements
Customizable pick-up priority settings for Auto Pickup
Audio muting options in-match: Mute all messages or mute voice only
Collections tab moved inside Vault menu
Added Fitting Room with up to 2 preset loadouts for costume outfits
Replay function auto-saves up to 18 most recent matches
Both kills and assists qualify for Daily First-Win mission in BR Ranked
Backpack skin becomes translucent when crosshairs overlap to maintain vision
